name: A Wish of Snow
source:
Despite the sudden snowfall, the annual Winter Ball was, unfortunately, not cancelled. This was the perfect opportunity for Lady Solange Beaufort, the only daughter of a duke, to find a husband and save her estate. Only, her heart longs for not for any of these pompous nobles, but a mysterious man she'd met the last time it snowed in the kingdom. Will her wish to see him again come true? Or is Solange doomed to a cold winter without the warmth of his embrace?

[From [url=https://floramisu.itch.io/a-wish-of-snow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尽管突然降雪，但不幸的是，一年一度的冬季舞会并没有取消。对于公爵的独生女索兰吉·博福特夫人来说，这是寻找丈夫并挽救财产的绝佳机会。只是，她内心渴望的不是这些浮夸的贵族，而是她上次在王国下雪时遇到的神秘男人。她再次见到他的愿望还能实现吗？或者索兰热注定要度过一个寒冷的冬天，没有他温暖的怀抱吗？

[来自[url=https://floramisu.itch.io/a-wish-of-snow]itch.io[/url]]
